title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: A confidence interval gives a range of values that is likely to contain the population parameter. The width of the interval depends on the confidence level.

title: Confidence Level and Interval Width
text: Higher confidence levels result in wider intervals because they need to cover more possible values to ensure the parameter is within the interval.

title: Comparing 95% and 90% Confidence Intervals
text: Consider the confidence levels: 95% and 90%. Which one would require a wider interval to ensure the parameter is captured?
